answer_4.quote: Each image was assessed by three human raters according to the guidelines of the defined task, and a final score in the range [0.0, 1.0] was reported for the average score.
answer_4.guideline: Images are scored in two aspects: (1) Semantic Consistency assesses how well the generated image aligns with the given conditions, such as prompts and subject tokens, ensuring coherence and relevance to the specified task criteria. (2) Perceptual Quality evaluates the extent to which the generated image appears visually authentic and conveys a sense of naturalness.
